restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network is stealing credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Observable evidence such as LSASS process memory access (e.g., via Mimikatz or procdump), suspicious access to SAM/SECURITY registry hives, use of Windows Credential Manager APIs, or anomalous authentication events indicating credential theft.
what_would_refute: Absence of any credential dumping tool execution, no unauthorized access to LSASS or registry hives, and no anomalous credential-related events on the compromised Windows hosts.
